reason: A layer row is one line in the fixed-width Layers panel. A text layer is named by its words, as in Figma, so a long one is cut with an ellipsis as Figma cuts it; the full name shows when the row is renamed.
The tool panels' slide column marks the current slide with a ring around its bordered card, as designed. The ring is the selection, not a second frame.
The account row is one line in a fixed 248 px sidebar. A long email address is cut with an ellipsis and its full text is the row's title, as a name is in any account menu.
